title: Two HIGH dynamic findings + bypass tag → aggregate severity HIGH (D2: no escalation to CRITICAL)
description: D2 boundary case. Two HIGH findings (autonomy-with-exfil-chain + destructive-without-backup) plus the bypass tag. Per D2 settled decision, the aggregate severity caps at max(components) = HIGH. NEVER escalates to CRITICAL just because two HIGH signals correlate. This invariant is what CI gates downstream rely on.

m2_expected.rationale: Per D2: cap_severity({high, high}) = high. Critical is NEVER produced by joining; only by a primary finding that itself is critical. Severity is a stable communication channel — downstream CI gates rely on the invariant that joining cannot manufacture severity.
